summary: Friends + Group DMs feature is fully working end-to-end. Backend: 36/36 pytest cases passed against /api/community/friends/{status,request,accept,decline,list,DELETE} and /api/community/dm/threads/group + /name + /members (add/remove) + group messaging + inbox projection — including all idempotency, 400/403/404 edge cases, the 50-member cap, last-member-deletes-thread behavior, and auto_name composition for groups. Frontend: confirmed dm-new-group button in inbox, new-group-screen renders with disabled Create at opacity 0.4 → 1.0 only when ≥2 friends are selected, all friend rows render with new-group-row-{uid}, chips appear with new-group-chip-{uid}, search filters by name, counter shows '2 selected · 47 more allowed', creating a group with a name routes via router.replace to /community/dm/group:{id} and that thread renders dm-thread-group-info ('Lectio Crew · 4 members · tap to manage'). User-profile button correctly toggles 'Add friend' → 'Cancel request' → 'Friends' based on friendship state. Pre-existing 'shadow* style props deprecated' warnings remain (carried from earlier iterations) and react-native-youtube-iframe still fails to compile the meditation route — neither is introduced by this iteration.

react_native_issues.issue: Console emits 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' on every screen including new-group.tsx (uses theme `shadow.card` on the friend row). Pre-existing — same warning reported in iterations 21 & 22. Reference: /app/frontend/app/community/dm/new-group.tsx:361 (`...shadow.card`) and shared theme.

Metro web bundler still fails to resolve 'react-native-web-webview' (pre-existing). Does not affect this iteration. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/SanctuaryAudio.tsx via /app/sanctuary/meditation.tsx.

(Optional / pre-existing) Install `react-native-web-webview` or stub `react-native-youtube-iframe` so /sanctuary/meditation compiles on web.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:friend_request correctly uses community_svc.friendship_key for an order-independent unique key; idempotent when pending; 400 only when status='accepted'; 403 when blocked; 404 when target missing. All paths verified.
server.py:friend_accept rejects the sender (400 'You sent this request…'), is idempotent when already accepted, and writes accepted_at. Verified.
server.py:friend_decline returns {ok:true} for the no-edge case (idempotent) and 400 when status='accepted' (forces unfriend) — matches the spec.
server.py:friend_list correctly scopes incoming = pending AND requested_by != caller; outgoing = pending AND requested_by == caller; accepted = status='accepted'. Cross-user isolation verified.

server.py:dm_create_group dedupes payload member_ids, removes the creator from the requested list, requires ≥1 other, enforces MAX_GROUP_MEMBERS=50 inclusive of creator, and returns thread with members[], is_group=true, auto_name composed from non-viewer member names.
server.py:dm_rename_group, add/remove_member, and dm_messages for groups all gate by `is_group AND caller in member_ids` and 404 otherwise — verified with non-member outsiders.
Last-member-leave correctly deletes both the thread doc and all its messages (community_dm_messages.delete_many). Verified by direct Mongo check after the final leave.
thread_public auto_name excludes the viewer for a contextual title; falls back to all-names when the viewer is the only member; truncates to '{a}, {b} + N others' beyond 3. Logic looks correct.

new-group.tsx friend list comes from friendList('accepted') with stable alpha sort and MAX_OTHERS=49 (mirrors 50-cap with creator subtracted). Selection state via Record<user_id,user>; toggle handles dedupe and the cap with an Alert. UI states all wired to testIDs as specified.
